text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide... And Taishin? What are you
two doing here? Oh, were you
invited to
the party too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We're not here for that...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We came to have our own party. I had no
idea this was the same
location as yours...
What incredible odds.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your own party, just the two of you...
Huh? Two? Um, aren't you...
missing
someone?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean Ticket? She's in bed
sleeping off a cold. Actually, this
party
was her suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's... unfortunate. She must have
been looking forward to it.
Aren't you
going to miss her?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really! I mean, she knows better than
to let a cold stop her...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, she's right. It's just as Taishin
says—we've nothing to be sad
about. You
see, Ticket promised us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She promised to speed along her recovery
and rush right over.
Considering it's her, I
really believe a miracle like that could
happen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay... Yeah, with all the energy she's
got, she'll probably blow
that cold right
out of her system.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. So we'll proceed as scheduled for
the time being and start
preparing until
she arrives.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, isn't that enough about us? You
were in a hurry stepping out.
You have
something to do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's right, I need to find a present as
fast as possible!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A present? From you to the fans?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone went through the trouble
of planning this party for
me, so I want to
give them something in return.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But... then I started thinking about all the
good food that'd be here,
and suddenly it
was today already...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Is she for real?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Right! Hayahide, you knew exactly how I
felt the other day. You're
really smart.
Would you please lend me your wits for
this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Certainly. I'd be happy to assist. But first,
tell me what kind of gift
you were thinking
about giving.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well... I mean, it'd have to be something
that'd make them all
happy... and glad...
and excited... and overjoyed. A present
like that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your sentiment is splendid, but I'm afraid
it's a little lacking in details.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know. Why don't you try drawing from
past experience?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Past experience?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For example, what's something you've
received before that made you
happy?
What filled you with joy?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh! I remember! There was
something I got when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
One year there was a big tag tournament I
joined. I remember I
wanted to ask Santa
for a carrot if I won.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But all I could think about was playing
tag... I completely forgot to
write a letter
to Santa. But somehow...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I got first in the tournament, and when I
went home I found it under
the tree...
There was a card that said "Congrats on
getting first!" on
top of a big basket of
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I didn't write the letter though, so how'd
Santa know? I wondered if
my mom told
him, but I never told her or anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was really surprised. Santa's amazing, I
thought... That was the
happiest I ever felt
on a holiday.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So if I could become Santa... I'd know what
would make everyone
happy? I just need
to find some flying reindeer...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Erm, I don't think that's the lesson to be
learned here. Though seeing
things from
Santa's point of view is an excellent idea.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What could make everyone happy and is
also something you're
capable of giving? I
believe the answer already lies within you,
Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've got it inside me? ...All right, I'll
try thinking it out! Thanks!
You too,
Taishin, for listening to my problem!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Uh! ...You sure she really gets it? That
sudden burst of enthusiasm is
giving me
déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The two of them share the same
earnestness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And what about that story of hers? It was
definitely her mom, wasn't
it? It doesn't
take a genius to figure out Oguri would
love to get
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you're correct. But it isn't our
place to tell her that Santa was
her mother
all along.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She should be able to find a present now. Or maybe I should've explained a little further...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Control freak. We did plenty—achoo!
Geez... Come on, it's freezing.
Let's get
inside already and prep our party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right you are. Let's make things perfect by
this evening and give
Ticket a nice
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If anyone can make a miracle happen on a
day like this, it's her. If she
doesn't pull
through, there will be a great deal of food
left over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What? You mean you took care of the food already? Ugh, I knew these boxes were way too heavy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You said I didn't need to bring anything,
so I thought we were making
stuff here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm counting on you to help
with all the decorations and
setting up we
need to do. And you'll be working double
since Ticket's
not here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's really gotten cold out though. And the
report said it'd be sunny all
day. Well,
we'll just have to keep an eye on the
weather.
